stories.title: Coastguard helicopter and Flint lifeboat search River Dee after report of person in water
stories.summary: A search of the River Dee after a report of a possible person in the water at the Blue Bridge in Queensferry has been stood down, with nothing found. stories.title: Shotton water supply disrupted by burst main, with repair expected by midday
stories.summary: Homes in Shotton, Higher Shotton and Queensferry may have low pressure or no water this morning after a burst water main. stories.title: Seven-court padel club planned for former warehouse in Mold
stories.summary: Plans have been submitted to turn a former warehouse on Bromfield Industrial Estate in Mold into an indoor padel centre with seven courts. stories.title: Holywell and Connah’s Quay shop raids net £3,200 of illegal tobacco and vapes
stories.summary: Around 6,500 illegal cigarettes and 150 banned disposable vapes have been seized in raids on shops in Holywell and Connah’s Quay. Flintshire County Council Trading Standards officers also took nearly 3kg of hand-rolling tobacco, with the council putting the street value of the haul at £3,200. stories.title: Flintshire mum who started running last year completes first half marathon for Wales Air Ambulance
stories.summary: A Flintshire hairdresser who only started running last year has raised £1,448 for Wales Air Ambulance after completing her first half marathon. Rachel Squires, 51, from Bryn-y-Baal, set out to raise £250, and ended up with nearly six times that amount.
